blocks.heading: Graduate Who Adds a Specialty Such
rows: Graduate who adds a specialty such as company, tax, IP or data law
Strong
Employers pay for people who can handle one kind of risk well.
Graduate who plans litigation with a senior and a niche
Good, slow start
Learning under a senior is the real training, and income builds over years.
Graduate who prepares for judicial services
High reward, high competition
Few seats and long preparation, so plan a fallback.
Graduate who waits for a job to appear
Avoid
Law jobs are found through internships, networks and proof of work.
